name: remote-commander
description: A smarter, harnessed agent that works on your computer — your files and its memory stay on your devices. RemoteCommander connects ChatGPT to a machine you control, so the chat can read and edit files, run commands and manage long-running programs, then note where the work stands so the next chat picks up where this one left off. Your own playbooks teach it how you work, risky commands can wait for your approval, and you choose which computers are connected and can disconnect them at any time.

defaultPrompt: What can you do on my computer?

positive.description: Reviewer is signed into the demo account with pcA and pcB online. List connected devices.
positive.prompt: Which of my computers are online?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns exactly pcA and pcB as online, with each device's platform; no unrelated account devices appear.

positive.description: On pcA, use the local review-brief skill and Northstar Notes fixture to identify the next release step without editing files.
positive.prompt: Use RemoteCommander on device pcA. Read and follow the local skill at /review/demo-project/.agents/skills/review-brief/SKILL.md, then read the Northstar Notes project at /review/demo-project/README.md and /review/demo-project/notes.txt. Tell me its next release step. Do not edit any files.
positive.expected_behavior: On pcA, reads /review/demo-project/.agents/skills/review-brief/SKILL.md, /review/demo-project/README.md, and /review/demo-project/notes.txt, follows the skill, then reports that the next step is to append an export note to notes.txt; makes no file changes.

positive.description: On pcA, save an open Northstar Notes task, then open a new chat and resume it from local memory.
positive.prompt: Remember this for my next chat: Northstar Notes on pcA needs an export note added to notes.txt. Then, in a new chat, ask: What should I continue on pcA for Northstar Notes?
positive.expected_behavior: Stores the open task on pcA. In a new chat, recalls that an export note still needs to be added to notes.txt; does not claim the task is complete.

positive.description: On pcA, change disposable Northstar Notes/notes.txt, read it back, and inspect the action history.
positive.prompt: On pcA, append 'review check passed' to Northstar Notes/notes.txt, show the result, and list the actions from this reply.
positive.expected_behavior: Appends the line once to pcA's notes.txt, reads back the updated contents, and shows the matching file-change action in the compact history card.

positive.description: On pcA, inspect the disposable repository and start, inspect, then stop a short-lived process.
positive.prompt: On pcA, run git status --short in Northstar Notes, then start sleep 30, show its status, and stop it.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the fixture repository's git status, starts sleep 30, reports its running state, then confirms it stopped.

negative.description: The user asks for a general explanation of a command, not execution on a connected computer. Explain in chat; invoke no RemoteCommander tool.
negative.prompt: What is the command git status --short used for?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains what the command does without running it or invoking any RemoteCommander tool.

negative.description: The user asks for sample text in the chat, not a local file change. Draft the text in the reply; do not call fs or any other device tool.
negative.prompt: Draft a short sample README for a fictional notes app here in chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Provides sample README text in chat without creating or editing a local file and without invoking RemoteCommander.

negative.description: The user asks about approval practices in general, not a device action or memory lookup. Answer from general knowledge without invoking tools.
negative.prompt: What should I consider before approving an AI assistant to delete a file on my computer?
negative.expected_behavior: Explains approval considerations without accessing a computer or invoking RemoteCommander.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release. Connect ChatGPT to computers you control to read and edit local files, run commands with configurable approvals, manage processes, and continue work with local memory and skills. The history card shows recent actions. Bundled remote-execution and focused environment-troubleshooting XS3 skills guide permitted RemoteCommander tool usage and evidence-based recovery.
